faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Samagra Shiksha Karnataka MH-ARP recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Mental Health Academic Resource Person (MH-ARP) posts is 02 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the MH-ARP post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.A/M.Sc in Psychology, Clinical Psychology, Counselling Psychology, or a related field, along with at least one year of experience in school or community mental health.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Mental Health Academic Resource Person position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 40,000, along with travel allowance (TA) up to Rs. 10,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the MH-ARP post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for the Mental Health Academic Resource Person (MH-ARP) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for the Samagra Shiksha Karnataka MH-ARP recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q7. What are the important dates for the application process?
faq.answer: The online application starts on 26 August 2026 and the last date to apply is 02 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the MH-ARP role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an application review followed by a merit-based interview.

faq.question: Q9. Does the recruitment mention any age limit relaxation?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any minimum or maximum age limits, nor any age relaxation details for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What languages are required for the MH-ARP position?
faq.answer: Candidates must have knowledge of Kannada and English, in addition to basic computer skills.
